name: FAB_TRACK_MIN
note: minimum track width (JLCPCB 2-layer 1 oz: 5 mil)

name: FAB_CLEARANCE_MIN
note: minimum copper-to-copper spacing (JLCPCB: 5 mil)

name: FAB_VIA_DRILL_MIN
note: minimum via drill on 1- and 2-layer boards (JLCPCB)

name: FAB_VIA_DIA_MIN
note: minimum via pad diameter on 1- and 2-layer boards (JLCPCB)

name: FAB_ANNULAR_MIN
note: minimum annular ring, plated holes (PCBWay 6 mil; JLCPCB 0.13 at 1 oz): the larger of the two

name: FAB_PTH_DRILL_MIN
note: minimum plated hole (JLCPCB)

name: FAB_NPTH_MIN
note: minimum non-plated hole (JLCPCB); mouse bites are made at least this size

name: FAB_NPTH_TOL
note: non-plated hole size tolerance +- (JLCPCB)

name: FAB_OUTLINE_TOL
note: routed outline tolerance +- (JLCPCB regular precision); tab / slot fits are sized for it

name: FAB_SLOT_NPTH_MIN
note: minimum non-plated slot width (JLCPCB; PCBWay 0.8)

name: FAB_EDGE_CLEAR_MIN
note: minimum copper to routed board edge (JLCPCB)

name: FAB_HOLE_CLEAR_MIN
note: minimum copper to a hole of another net: JLCPCB via-to-track and NPTH-to-track, 10 mil

name: FAB_HOLE_TO_HOLE_MIN
note: minimum hole-to-hole spacing, holes on different nets (JLCPCB)

name: FAB_MASK_BRIDGE_MIN
note: minimum solder mask web between pads (JLCPCB green; 0.254 other colours)

name: FAB_SILK_LINE_MIN
note: minimum silkscreen line and text stroke width (JLCPCB: 6 mil); thinner silk is widened to this

name: FAB_SILK_TEXT_MIN
note: minimum silkscreen text height (JLCPCB: 40 mil; PCBWay 0.8); smaller text is enlarged to this

name: FAB_SILK_TO_PAD_MIN
note: minimum silkscreen to pad clearance (JLCPCB)

name: FAB_BREAKAWAY_TAB_MIN
note: minimum breakaway tab width with mouse bites (JLCPCB: 4 mm, 5 mm with mouse bites); sets the knockout bridges

name: FAB_MIN_QTY
note: minimum order per design (JLCPCB and PCBWay)

name: FAB_THICK_TOL
note: board thickness tolerance (JLCPCB: +-10 % for 1.0 mm and up, so 1.6 mm is 1.44-1.76); slot widths are checked against it
